attributes.description: TOR relay activity from the Onionoo API (ti_tor integration).

query.esql: FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS `Relays` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.fingerprint)
FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS `Relays` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.fingerprint)

FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS `Exit relays` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.fingerprint) WHERE ti_tor.node_activity.detail.Exit IS NOT NULL

FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS `Exit relays` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.fingerprint) WHERE ti_tor.node_activity.detail.Exit IS NOT NULL

FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS `BadExit relays` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.fingerprint) WHERE ti_tor.node_activity.detail.BadExit IS NOT NULL

FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS `BadExit relays` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.fingerprint) WHERE ti_tor.node_activity.detail.BadExit IS NOT NULL
FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS `Relay countries` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.routing.ipv4.geo.country_iso_code)
FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS `Relay countries` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.routing.ipv4.geo.country_iso_code)

FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE ti_tor.node_activity.exit.geo.country_name IS NOT NULL | STATS `Exit relays` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.fingerprint) BY Country = ti_tor.node_activity.exit.geo.country_name | SORT `Exit relays` DESC | LIMIT 10

FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE ti_tor.node_activity.exit.geo.country_name IS NOT NULL | STATS `Exit relays` = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.fingerprint) BY Country = ti_tor.node_activity.exit.geo.country_name | SORT `Exit relays` DESC | LIMIT 10

FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE ti_tor.node_activity.as.organization.name IS NOT NULL | STATS Relays = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.fingerprint) BY `AS organization` = ti_tor.node_activity.as.organization.name | SORT Relays DESC | LIMIT 10

FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE ti_tor.node_activity.as.organization.name IS NOT NULL | STATS Relays = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.fingerprint) BY `AS organization` = ti_tor.node_activity.as.organization.name | SORT Relays DESC | LIMIT 10
FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS Changes = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS Changes = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE ti_tor.node_activity.version_status IS NOT NULL | STATS Relays = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.fingerprint) BY Status = ti_tor.node_activity.version_status

FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE ti_tor.node_activity.version_status IS NOT NULL | STATS Relays = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.fingerprint) BY Status = ti_tor.node_activity.version_status

FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE ti_tor.node_activity.version IS NOT NULL | STATS Relays = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.fingerprint) BY Version = ti_tor.node_activity.version | SORT Relays DESC | LIMIT 8

FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE ti_tor.node_activity.version IS NOT NULL | STATS Relays = COUNT_DISTINCT(ti_tor.node_activity.fingerprint) BY Version = ti_tor.node_activity.version | SORT Relays DESC | LIMIT 8

FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE ti_tor.node_activity.exit.ip IS NOT NULL | STATS `Observed bandwidth` = MAX(ti_tor.node_activity.bandwidth.observed), `Last seen` = MAX(ti_tor.node_activity.last_seen) BY Relay = ti_tor.node_activity.name, `Exit IP` = ti_tor.node_activity.exit.ip, Country = ti_tor.node_activity.exit.geo.country_name, `AS organization` = ti_tor.node_activity.exit.as.organization.name | SORT `Observed bandwidth` DESC NULLS LAST | LIMIT 100

FROM logs-ti_tor.node_activity-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE ti_tor.node_activity.exit.ip IS NOT NULL | STATS `Observed bandwidth` = MAX(ti_tor.node_activity.bandwidth.observed), `Last seen` = MAX(ti_tor.node_activity.last_seen) BY Relay = ti_tor.node_activity.name, `Exit IP` = ti_tor.node_activity.exit.ip, Country = ti_tor.node_activity.exit.geo.country_name, `AS organization` = ti_tor.node_activity.exit.as.organization.name | SORT `Observed bandwidth` DESC NULLS LAST | LIMIT 100
